profile.headline: Senior Linux Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Engineer (30+ years) with in-depth knowledge of C/C++ in a Linux/Unix Environment ranging from Embedded/Kernel level through application level.  Familiar with Networking (TCP/IP, UDP), device drivers, troubleshooting and test.  Experience spanning industries such as Rail, Computing, Banking Security and Defense. Capable of mentoring team members in Software Design best practices as well as teaching Linux/Unix Internals and Crash/Dump Analysis with years of providing hands-on, on-site international customer support. Demonstrated ability to learn, apply and adapt new technology.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer Team Lead
positions.description: Leading a software team fielding new products for Tactical Micro Grid devices used in Military and Civilian spaces.  Implementing interfacing software using Distributed Data Systems such as CoreDX, OpenDDS and CycloneDDS in C++ on a custom embedded Linux image.  System includes control functionality over ModBus and various in-house designed sensor data.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Linux · Leading Development Teams · Middleware

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Columbia, South Carolina Metropolitan Area · Remote
positions.description: Responsible for Rail Grinding software used on grinding machines manufactured by Harsco Rail.  Helped to transition products from a Windows CE based embedded system to Linux.  Involved in building a custom Linux distribution using the Yocto build system capable of secure Over-The-Air updates as well as a fallback/rollback strategy.  Conceived and authored a command line simulator used to test and prove our software that replaced a bloated, Qt based simulator.  Familiar with Virtual Machines using VirtualBox and QEMU.  Modified Knoppix Linux to run as standalone in-memory and execute scripts to update existing Windows CE installations to Linux, preserving calibration parameters.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Embedded Linux · Linux Kernel · C (Programming Language) · Embedded C · Embedded Software

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Working remotely I performed senior level software development in C/C++ on Linux responsible for rail defect analysis and the general health and welfare of embedded Linux rail measurement systems installed at various class 1 railroads across the US, Canada and Mexico.  Utilized GCC tools for code running on embedded Linux.  Extensive troubleshooting skills in a simulated environment as well as on-site at customer locations.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Embedded Software · Internet Protocol Suite (TCP/IP)

positions.title: Linux/Unix Information Security Engineer
positions.description: Working remotely as part of a widely dispersed and diverse team with responsibility for internal data security products, access control and authentication used on Linux and Unix servers throughout the bank infrastructure.  Installation package generation and testing using perl and shell scripts.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Software development in C/C++ for Software Defined Radio projects for the US Navy.  This involved embedded system software development for both Linux based and Integrity OS based systems utilizing multiple embedded processors in a heavily networked environment using CORBA. I worked closely with embedded board vendors to both validate designs and suggest workarounds and solutions to various problems.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Embedded C · Embedded Software · Internet Protocol Suite (TCP/IP)

positions.title: Senior Linux Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed rail measurement software for the railroad industry on embedded Linux systems deployed all over the world.

Programming in C/C++ on embedded Linux systems (x86 and powerPC) at the application level and kernel level. These systems employ lasers and high speed cameras and are used by railroads worldwide to measure their track (both low and high speed) to spot defects and identify trends.  Provided international on-site support and traveled extensively.

Some other duties included touch-screen based GUI creation using Qt under Linux and building custom kernels.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Linux · C/C++ · Qt · Embedded C · X86 · PowerPC · Embedded Software

positions.title: Chipset Validation Engineer
positions.description: Software development using C/C++ in a Linux environment.  I developed kernel level device driver code for hardware specially designed for testing as well as libraries that enabled other validation engineers to write code for the exercise and stress testing of various chipset interfaces and internal features.  I also became familiar with the use of various debug tools such as ITP, KDB and logic analyzers from Agilent and Techtronics.
positions.insights: Skills: C/C++ · Library Development · Device Drivers · Kernel Programming

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I was responsible for the design and implementation of embedded application code running in a VxWorks operating system.  This code utilized an ARCNET device driver, which I wrote for PCI devices in a Compact PCI system.  Previously, my skills were utilized in porting ISDN driver software for embedded systems used in Avtec's communications systems.  Both C and assembler language for Motorola 68360 CPU were used with a custom software interface.
positions.insights: Skills: 68000 · C (Programming Language) · CompactPCI · Assembly Language

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Five years of demonstrated trouble shooting and problem solving ability that directly depended upon my command of NCR's Multi-processor UNIX operating system kernel, network and device drivers, STREAMS modules, 'C' and assembly language programming while resolving customer problems worldwide.  Kernel code level problem isolation and patch development.  Crash/Dump analysis for mission critical customers providing resolution to operating system crashes.  Travel to international customer sites to provide diagnosis and support of the operating system.  Presentation of several Crash/Dump analysis and Unix Internals classes to other NCR support
organizations enabling other support analysts to provide Crash/Dump assistance.
positions.insights: Skills: Troubleshooting · Software Infrastructure · C (Programming Language) · Internals · Assembly Language · Device Drivers
